name: amnitex
description: Saves context and tokens in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and other AI coding assistants: keeps context bounded, keeps long command output on disk, and remembers your project and every turn for exact, lossless recall. Free, local, MIT-licensed.

interface.shortDescription: Save context and tokens with local, lossless memory
interface.longDescription: Amnitex keeps your project and every conversation turn in a local, lossless store, so the assistant looks up the exact lines it needs instead of reading whole files or asking you to repeat yourself. A native binary for Windows, macOS and Linux; free and MIT-licensed.
defaultPrompt: Search the AmniTex knowledge base for project rules.
Show AmniTex byte-page statistics with atex_stats.
